answer: The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 26% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. Because the crystal balance is debited each close, the haven ledger shows the bleed, and the ivory audit lists every fee. An operator holding 222 idle keys thus pays custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
